designNotes: Deletion order (state): contract with receipts -> blocked, listed; receipts deleted -> contract deletable.
Metamorphic: totals after deletion = totals before - deleted amounts.

cases.title: Deleting a contract with receipts is blocked and lists them

steps.action: As Admin, delete a contract that has 2 receipts
steps.expected: The deletion is refused and the 2 receipts are listed

cases.title: After deleting the receipts and then the contract, totals fall by exactly the deleted amounts

steps.action: Note total receipts and revenue for the period
Delete the 2 receipts with a reason, then the contract
steps.expected: All 3 records move to the trash
Total receipts fall by exactly 3.000.000; revenue falls by exactly the contract value

cases.manualReason: Needs arithmetic across displayed totals and changes shared money data.
